text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Haa, ngh...!!
Haa, haa, haa—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Right now, I gave it the best run I could...!
The results are beyond reproach, too.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (Just—)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Fans
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOOOH!! Sweeep~~!
That was awesome again today! You totally blew us away!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Strong and adorable, our very own witch!
Sweep Toshooooo!!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Fans
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAAHH!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (Such incredible excitement. But... I can't help but... agree!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(I can't help but completely agree!
The running of Sweep-san's that I felt firsthand was just far too—)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (Out of the ordinary, utterly unbelievable, almost completely outrageous—...)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (My heart leaped.)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Messiah!
Hmph... you're not half bad yourself.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ah... Sweep-san—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Well, but I'm satisfied.
Because you—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Your expression looks waaaay better
than it did before the race! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, you felt that thrill, didn't you?
Isn't my magic amazing?!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ngh, ...—magic.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: So this is... your magic...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Race magic.
My special secret weapon!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's super-duper important magic
that Grandma taught me!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ! Sweep-san's grandmother...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (Magic. A power that enchants everyone, overturns everything, and even rewrites an era... magic.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(From grandmother to granddaughter.
Carefully woven together, and—)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (Handed down, inherited... magic—!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much, Sweep-san.
It was a true honor to compete with you here today.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"It was truly... a wonderful piece of magic.
Please give my regards to your grandmother."

"And upon returning to the waiting room,
Air Messiah quietly... began to speak."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: It must be an inheritance... just as I thought.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you remember
what Mother said?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...I was thinking about it.
And today, I touched upon a sort of answer.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Did you see it? Sweep-san's magic.
That sparkle that thrilled everyone's hearts—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I heard that was handed down from her grandmother.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: It was that very connection... that touched my heart the most.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Not to dwell on the past.
Not to avenge my mother's regrets—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
If I had to declare one thing...
that I myself aim to achieve from here on out...
I said so with excitement in my heart. Because for her, who treasured her mother above all and knew the value of their bond, it felt like the best path to take.
However, Air Messiah was—
...Air Messiah did not nod.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...No.
I'm so sorry, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "Am I, too, striving for inheritance?"...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
As for the answer to that question...
Could you please wait just a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: No... um—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Frankly speaking, right now...
I cannot even answer that question.
...I simply do not know how to respond.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "Just please give me a little more time to think. Time to... face myself."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...For my target race, I would love to set my sights on
the Victoria Mile, the major race of the spring Tiara route."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
And by that time... I will certainly
reach a definitive answer.
choice_data_list: Got it. For now... I'll be waiting.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

"While it's still a concern, unlike during the summer training camp,
she's opening up and sharing her honest feelings with me."

"If that's the case, all I can do is prepare for the Victoria Mile
while waiting for her answer."

With that resolved in my heart,
I watched over Air Messiah for the time being.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (...—I think...)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Ever since I was little, I've only ever
seen myself as 'my mother's daughter.')

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(The act of looking at 'myself'...
is something I am so clumsy at.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Still, I have to come up with it.
My answer, before the Victoria Mile.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (I want to give them an answer. My own answer!)
